introduction: Texas WIC starts online or by phone, followed by a local nutrition appointment. The clinic determines eligibility and issues benefits after that review.
description: Texas WIC starts online or by phone, followed by a local nutrition appointment. The clinic determines eligibility and issues benefits after that review.

sections.who: Texas residents who are pregnant, postpartum or breastfeeding and children younger than five can be assessed. Income and nutrition conditions apply.
sections.get: WIC food benefits, nutrition guidance and breastfeeding support.
sections.docs:
• Address and identity evidence.
  • Income or qualifying benefit-program records.
  • Clinic-requested information for each applicant.
sections.apply:
1. Start intake

    Use Texas WIC online intake or call 800-942-3678.

  2. Attend the appointment

    The local team explains records and performs the nutrition review.

  3. Learn the card rules

    If approved, review eligible foods and shopping instructions.
sections.after: Keep clinic appointments and tell the clinic if you move so records and benefits can be transferred.
sections.sources: Checked October 1, 2026 using Texas WIC application and eligibility. USA Assistance background guide. Program staff determine eligibility and available assistance.

faqs: Yes. Parents and guardians can apply for eligible children.
Does SNAP automatically finish WIC enrollment?
SNAP can establish income eligibility, but a WIC assessment is still required.
Can I use the Texas card in another state?
Texas WIC says its card is only usable in Texas; ask for transfer records before moving.

provenance.scope: Published eligibility, service purpose and application pathway; no unverified financial limits or deadlines included.
